facts.note: Transcript states that at the temple's nine, Aurèle had everyone show their watches, and that Dr Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.

Transcript states piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by his watch, then he went to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat; Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back. The 'after dinner' timing is implied by the answer to 'And afterwards?'.
Transcript states that when the temple struck ten during the game, the salon clock showed five minutes to ten and he remarked on it to Madame.
